scope: Local execution environment; prepared outcomes reused, excludes cold simulation fitting, network and Streamlit rendering. No standings or postgame results used.
limitations: Single paired local comparison on a 275-player DK Classic slate. Candidate search and opponent field are unchanged, measured once and shared in replay totals. Not a benchmark of cold game simulation, network, live Streamlit Cloud, or a matched NBA slate. Counts, lineup rules, payout scaling and scoring precision are unchanged.
